name: Minamo Kazumi
source:
One of the 3 girls in Koudai's group. She is good at sports. She is especially fast on her feet and can even beat the boys. 

She is the most mature among the 3 girls, so she acts as a mediator in their fights.

She has younger twin sisters and is related to Koudai.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
